Author: Serpens66
Name: Vanilla AIC Exporter
Description: One-shot utility that exports the currently installed embedded vanilla AIC data as editor-compatible lordjson files.

Changes: Generate Portable PDB debug symbols for Unity Mono-compatible stack traces and debugging.
Support Steam build 24816905 after validating the native AIC layout, conversion, and official lord slots.
Export official embedded AIC slots as editor-compatible lordjson files.
Exclude runtime custom-lord slots and record game versions plus the native DLL SHA-256 in a manifest.
